name: Junsei Tenshi Primity☆Miel ~Yami ni Miirareta Twin Angel~
original_name: 純聖天使プリミティ☆ミエル～闇に魅入られたツインエンジェル～
source:
Back by popular demand! The long-awaited continuation of Pure and Holy Angel Purimity Noel has arrived! Starring an all-new pair of innocent angels to be ruthlessly violated. Returning fans please enjoy, or if you're new to the series, jump in without worry!

Protectors of mankind Purimity Noel and Purimity Canon have been missing for a month.
Mana (Purimity Mieru) and Mina (Purimity Elise) have successfully followed the path to demon Zabiera. They intend to extract information about the whereabouts of the other angels, but he slips through their fingers.

From above, Azazel watches events unfold, and begins a plan of bait and capture... 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE059169.html]English DLSite[/url]]
